baseline: Current post-ATR-correction SN1_H1; fit/reproduced from Train only, evaluated on exactly the requested 2024 target dates
train_window: Existing SN1_H1 fixed Train route; baseline models use Train feature rows and Train H1 target only

walk_forward_folds.train: reuse current frozen SN1_H1 training contract on Train only; no network candidate fit
walk_forward_folds.evaluation: descriptive historical Valid target, 2024-01-04 through 2024-12-30 inclusive

confirmation_policy: One-year historical Valid diagnostic explicitly requested by the user. Already-open development data, not holdout/OOS. Do not promote or retune a strategy from this slice.

trials.comparison: NCMOM20-only official covered-universe account versus SN1_H1 on the same covered rows; also show full-universe SN1_H1.

feature_definitions.graph: M5/M4 2026.09 current snapshot held fixed across 2024 under the user's persistence assumption; confirmed listed supplier to listed major_customer edges only
feature_definitions.NCMOM20: Equal-weight average of each mapped customer's last 20 finite observed residual returns with dates strictly earlier than supplier signal date; require full 20-observation history, reset after a >20 exchange-date-position listing gap, average available linked customers, leave feature missing if none are available
feature_definitions.missing: Do not impute missing NCMOM20 to zero; use covered suppliers only for NCMOM quintile/account and matched SN1 comparison
feature_definitions.code_mapping: M4 securities_code (four-character issue code) + trailing 0, validated against the exact 2024 market input panel

model: No NCMOM model or combined SN1_H1 candidate is fitted. Current SN1_H1 baseline is regenerated with the current fixed Train-only H1 route.
selection_rule: No strategy selection or model adoption from this already-open one-year Valid diagnostic. Report the observed descriptive metrics and graph/PIT limitation.
